# `api.lots.item_data`

> `POST /Lot/ItemData` — Catalog

**Python**

```python
api.lots.item_data(*, data: GetLotsItemDataQuery | dict) -> List[LotItemDataDto]
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab lots item_data [--data ...]
```

POST /Lot/ItemData.

Looks up item data for lots by their customer item IDs. Despite
the POST verb this is a read — the query travels in the body
because the ID list can be long.

Replaces the retired ``POST /Lot/get-overrides``.

Args:
    data: Query payload with ``partner_id`` (required),
        ``customer_item_ids``, ``customer_comments`` and
        ``other_ref_no``. Accepts a :class:`GetLotsItemDataQuery`
        instance or a dict.

Returns:
    list[LotItemDataDto]: Item data for the matched lots.

Request model: :class:`GetLotsItemDataQuery`

## Request body — `GetLotsItemDataQuery`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partnerId` | `int` | yes | Partner ID scoping the lookup |
| `customerComments` | `Optional[str]` | no | Filter by customer comments |
| `otherRefNo` | `Optional[str]` | no | Filter by other reference number |
| `customerItemIds` | `Optional[list[str]]` | no | Customer item IDs to look up |

## Response

Returns a list of `List[LotItemDataDto]`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `platformItemId` | `Optional[str]` | no | Platform item ID the data belongs to |
| `initialData` | `Optional[LotDataDto]` | no | Initial lot data |
| `itemData` | `Optional[list[LotDataDto]]` | no | Item data entries |
